This philosophy emphasizes the unique relationship between God and the individual soul. The name is also a symbol of wisdom, knowledge, and scholarship, which are cherished values in Indian culture.

The name imparts a sense of purpose, reminding the bearer to constantly seek and expand their understanding of the sacred knowledge of the universe.
